observations: Two black rectangular power banks lying on a concrete floor.
The top power bank is wrapped in yellowish tape, obscuring the label.
The bottom power bank has a visible scratch on the casing.
Both units have thick braided charging cables (green and blue).
A USB connector is visible in the top left corner of the frame.
The image quality is low-resolution and appears to be a single photo taken in a dim environment.

claims.evidence: The photo shows two units, but their capacity and condition are not confirmed.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead, swollen, or contain a degraded cell.
risks.proof: A video showing a clear, close-up shot of the battery label (photo 0) and a video of the device powering on a phone.

risks.risk: The device may be a counterfeit or a generic brand with inferior build quality.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the unit.

risks.risk: The output ports may be damaged or the cables may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the ports being used to charge a device.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the battery label on the back of the power bank to see the capacity (mAh).
Video of the power bank charging a phone to confirm it works.
Photo of the ports and the other end of the cables.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
